# nb-studio env

## env check

Check an environment

Requires the `rel.environments` `read` setting. Runs the driver check against the stored settings.

```bash
nb-studio env check <env>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `env`    |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.environments/read`.

**Request:** `POST /api/releases/environments/{environmentId}/check` (`releasesCheckEnvironment`)

## env create

Create an environment

Requires the `rel.environments` `manage` setting. Credentials are write-only and never returned.

```bash
nb-studio env create [<env>]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `env`    | (optional)  |

| Flag                            | Type     | Description                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--name`                        | string   |                                                                                                    |
| `--config`                      | json     |                                                                                                    |
| `--secret`                      | json     |                                                                                                    |
| `--secret-changes`              | json     |                                                                                                    |
| `--url`                         | string   |                                                                                                    |
| `--protected`                   | boolean  | Every deployment goes through a deployment request an approver approves; nothing deploys directly. |
| `--approvers`                   | string[] | (repeatable)                                                                                       |
| `--max-apps`                    | number   |                                                                                                    |
| `--default-idle-stop-minutes`   | number   |                                                                                                    |
| `--default-dormant-after-hours` | number   |                                                                                                    |
| `--registry`                    | string   |                                                                                                    |
| `--sample-data-on-first-deploy` | boolean  | An App’s first deployment here loads its sample data (`APP_SAMPLE_DATA=true`).                     |
| `--driver`                      | string   |                                                                                                    |
| `--file`                        | path     | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.                                  |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.environments/manage`.

**Request:** `POST /api/releases/environments` (`releasesCreateEnvironment`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio env create staging --name Staging --driver host --protected
nb-studio env create production --file production.json
```

## env delete

Requires the `rel.environments` `manage` setting.

```bash

```

| -------- | ----------- |
| `env`    |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                       |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------- |

## env driver list

List deployment drivers

Requires the `rel.environments` `read` setting, access to the Apps page, or the `create` action on every App.

```bash
nb-studio env driver list
```

**Output:** A list (table columns: `kind`, `title.key`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.environments/read`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/drivers` (`releasesListDrivers`)

## env var declared

List the variables an environment's Apps declare

Requires the `rel.environments` `read` setting. The variables the most recent build of each App of the environment declares (its newest release with a variables manifest), merged by name: which Apps declare each, whether the environment sets it, and which Apps require it and get no value. Only Apps the caller may view count. No value is returned.

```bash
nb-studio env var declared <env>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `env`    |             |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `name`, `required`, `set`, `apps`, `missingIn`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.environments/read`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/environments/{environmentId}/declaredVariables` (`releasesListEnvironmentDeclaredVariables`)

## env var list

List an environment's variables

Requires the `rel.environments` `read` setting. Every App of the environment gets these unless it sets its own. A secret’s value is never returned.

```bash
nb-studio env var list <env>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `env`    |             |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `name`, `secret`, `value`, `updatedAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.environments/read`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/environments/{environmentId}/variables` (`releasesListEnvironmentVariables`)

## env var set

Set an environment's variable

Requires the `rel.environments` `manage` setting. Every App of the environment gets it with its next deployment, unless the App sets its own. A name the runtime sets itself (`NODE_ENV`, `APP_BASE_PATH`, …) is refused (`VARIABLE_RESERVED`).

```bash
nb-studio env var set <env> <name> <value>
```

| Argument | Description                |
| -------- | -------------------------- |
| `env`    |                            |
| `name`   |                            |
| `value`  | The value; at most 64 KiB. |

| Flag            | Type    | Description                                                                                                      |
| --------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--secret`      | boolean | Never shown again once set. Inferred from the name when left out (`…_PASSWORD`, `…_SECRET`, `…_TOKEN`, `…_KEY`). |
| `--description` | string  |                                                                                                                  |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.environments/manage`.

**Request:** `PUT /api/releases/environments/{environmentId}/variables/{name}` (`releasesSetEnvironmentVariable`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio env var set preview SMTP_HOST smtp.example.com
nb-studio env var set preview SMTP_PASSWORD --from-env
```

## env var unset

Remove an environment's variable

Requires the `rel.environments` `manage` setting.

```bash
nb-studio env var unset <env> <name>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `env`    |             |
| `name`   |             |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.environments/manage`.

**Request:** `DELETE /api/releases/environments/{environmentId}/variables/{name}` (`releasesDeleteEnvironmentVariable`)
